history.sql:
CREATE TABLE matched_entries (
                    entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    feed_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    topics TEXT NOT NULL,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    link TEXT NOT NULL,
                    summary TEXT,
                    authors TEXT,
                    abstract TEXT,
                    doi TEXT,
                    published_date TEXT,
